Africa Global Press is committed to protecting the privacy of your personal information. Your trust is important to us, and this Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your data.

This policy applies to all services offered by Africa Global Press, including our website , our mobile applications, and our newsletters.

We encourage you to read this policy carefully to understand our privacy practices. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at contact@pressafrica.media.

1. Collection and Use of Personal Information

We collect different types of personal information, depending on your interaction with our services:

We use this information for the following purposes:

  • Information you provide directly to us: This includes information you provide to us when you sign up for our newsletter, create an account, enter a contest, submit a comment, or contact our customer service. This information may include your name, email address, postal address, phone number, and any other information you choose to share with us.
  • Information Collected Automatically: When you use our Services, we automatically collect certain information about your device and browsing habits. This may include your IP address, browser type, operating system, the pages you view, the links you click, and the length of your visit. We use cookies and similar technologies to collect this information (see the "Cookies" section below).
  • Information from other sources: In some cases, we may receive information about you from third parties, such as advertising partners or social networks (if you use their services to connect to our site).
  • Providing and improving our services: This includes personalizing your experience, displaying relevant content, and improving the performance and security of our platforms.
  • Communicating with you: We may use your contact information to send you newsletters, information about our services, promotional offers, and respond to your support requests.
  • Display targeted advertisements: We may use your information to show you advertisements that are relevant to your interests.
  • Conducting analysis and research: We use the data collected to understand how our services are used, identify trends, and improve our offering.
  • Comply with our legal obligations: We may be required to disclose your personal information in response to a legal request (for example, a court order or subpoena).

2. Sharing of Personal Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with the following categories of recipients:

  • Service Providers: We use third-party service providers to help us deliver our services (e.g., web hosting, data analysis, email marketing, payment processing). These providers have access to your personal information only to the extent necessary to perform their tasks and are required to protect it in accordance with the law.
  • Advertising Partners: We may share non-personally identifiable information with our advertising partners to enable them to target advertisements displayed on our Services.
  • Legal Authorities: We may be required to disclose your personal information to legal authorities if required to do so by law or in response to a valid legal request.
  • Business Transfer: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your personal information may be transferred to the acquiring entity.

3. Cookies and Similar Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to automatically collect information about your browsing on our services. You can find more information about our use of cookies in our (Cookie policy).

4. Security of Personal Information

We take appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. These measures include:

Encryption of sensitive data,Controlling access to our systems,Regularly updating our security measures.

While we strive to protect your personal information, no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

5. Your Rights

You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • Right of Access: You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you.
  • Right of Rectification: You have the right to request the correction of any inaccurate or incomplete personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to Erasure: You have the right to request the deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions provided by law.
  • Right to Restriction of Processing: You have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal information in certain circumstances.
  • Right to Object: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal information for direct marketing or other legitimate purposes.
  • Right to Object: You have the right to receive your personal information in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and to transmit it to another controller. Right to Object: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal information for direct marketing or other legitimate purposes.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: If we process your personal information based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.

6. Types of Personal Information Collected

The personal information we may collect includes:

  • Identification Information: Last name, first name, email address.
  • Contact Information: Email address, phone number.
  • Demographic Information: Age, gender, country. (Only collected if you choose to provide it to us).
  • Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, browsing data.
  • Communication Information: Content of your communications with us.
  • Social Media Information: If you choose to link your social media account to our Services.

7. Duration of Retention of Personal Information

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may modify this privacy policy from time to time. We will post any changes on our website and encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about our privacy practices.
By subscribing to us, you authorize us to use and send you personal information that is related to and helps you.
